summary: The strategy covers all six phases with a targeted Red command, a Green gate, a closeout addition, a risk class, and an anti-pattern defense table for each. Risks are medium, medium, high, high, medium, low. The AudioBus phase gets Review B, Review C, adversarial, and browser review; the hand-off phase gets a reduced Review B. The strategy carries spec-review r2 F6 as a settlement: T8 Green creates MANIFEST.sha256 in sha256sum format so the plan done-when can pass. It also names a product wiring gap: no phase calls useSoundFiles or preload, so Phase 4 must supply the map inside its own harness.
nonblocking_findings: F6 carry-forward (spec-review r2, Major but nonblocking there): plan T8 checks out/apk-audio-handoff/chibi/MANIFEST.sha256, and no phase creates that file. The strategy settles it: T8 Green writes a sha256sum-format manifest (64 lowercase hex, two spaces, file name) from the committed bytes, keeps the MANIFEST.tsv sha256 column in agreement, and records the one-file addition in the plan for Review A. The hand-off folder then holds 17 files: 14 sound files, MANIFEST.tsv, MANIFEST.sha256, and README.md. Falsification: one wrong byte, a missing row, or a stale hash fails the Phase 5 gate.

Product wiring gap (nonblocking, plan-level): no task calls useSoundFiles or preload from a game or the demo. The AudioBus API is inert until a caller sets the map, so the Phase 3 unit proof and the browser review cannot observe a real file request on a stock game page. The strategy requires Phase 4 to create the map inside its own harness (a demo page, a launch-context field, or an in-page hook) and to exit non-zero on zero audio rows. No spec change is needed; scope control already permits demo files.

Phase 2 spec ambiguity (nonblocking): AC2 lists the per-entry check order as prepare, prepare, render Ogg, render MP3, and it also names ffmpeg-missing as a failure class. A literal per-entry read leaves a new .ogg on disk before the binary failure. The strategy settles fail-fast: check the ffmpeg binary once, before the first entry, so case 2 asserts zero earshot calls and zero output. Review A must confirm this reading; if Green checks per entry instead, case 2 must assert one Ogg call and no MP3 call.

Documentation gap (nonblocking): measure/anti-patterns.md does not exist in this repository. The strategy cites the canonical A1-A11 catalog and states per-phase defenses and falsification conditions anyway. A repo-local catalog would let future tracks link the guards directly.
